verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Numeral is an API-first tax SaaS, and such products commonly publish official client SDKs. The evidence shows only raw REST endpoints (POST to /tax/products, /tax/calculations, /tax/transactions), an MCP server, Claude skills and platform integrations. Nothing documents an official Numeral SDK or client library; the 'LLM SDK' mention refers to third-party agent SDKs, not a Numeral SDK. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at every candidate path, so there is no published spec for generating clients.
